tags.instructions: Use `get-job-post` first to review the form, required groups, consent requirements and disclosures; get post IDs from `list-job-posts`. Obtain actual applicant answers and consent—never infer them. Use `list-schools`, `list-degrees` and `list-disciplines` for education IDs. Submission creates an application and may trigger recruiting workflows. The result confirms API acceptance only, not delivery or hiring progress. Do not blindly repeat a submission with an uncertain outcome; this API has no documented replay protection.
